relations.subject: Willibald Kirfel
relations.evidence: In 1904-08 studies of Oriental languages and Catholic theology at Bonn.

relations.subject: Willibald Kirfel
relations.evidence: In 1911-21 Librarian in Bonn university library.

relations.subject: Willibald Kirfel
relations.evidence: In 1922 succeeded Jacobi as ord. Professor of Indology at Bonn.

relations.subject: Willibald Kirfel
relations.evidence: In 1922 succeeded Jacobi as ord. Professor of Indology at Bonn. Retired in 1953.
